subject: Someone clearly didn't understand the signs....
author: CrashedAlex
body:
Thinking back to NFS HP - I remember this sudden leak the night before the Show.

Basically someone with a contractor pass got into the exhibition hall the day before the Show. There are usually a few folks milling around checking construction setup before three days of chaos.

The demo area let players be online and could either "Race" (in a supercar) or "Chase" (play as the Cop) and the banners above the demo area showed that.

So, bizarrely, for 24 hours, people thought the game was called "Need for Speed Hot Pursuit Race.' - which did make me laugh.
